content_of_post_to_comment: When are we going to get up off our asses and fix the education system? Not as Democrats. Not as Republicans. As adults who owe children something better than overcrowded classrooms, exhausted teachers, endless testing, unmet needs, and another generation being asked to survive a system we already know is failing too many of them. At some point, this stops being about policy. It becomes about whether we care enough about kids to stop arguing over who is right and start doing what is right.
